tool_input.command: git ls-files | head -300 && echo "---TOTAL---" && git ls-files | wc -l

tool_input.description: Search filesystem for schema and example files

result:
The manifest wrote successfully with no lint feedback this time, meaning zero blocking errors. The decomposition is complete: 7 Logical Units across a 19-file Go source tree (spf13/cobra) —

- **command-tree** (domain) — the Command struct, tree, execution lifecycle
- **argument-validators** (domain) — positional-arg validation policies
- **flag-groups** (domain) — required-together/one-required/mutually-exclusive flag rules
- **flag-completion-annotations** (domain) — per-flag completion hint annotations, split out on two scouts' independent recommendation since it fit neither neighboring unit
- **completion-engine** (domain) — the shell-agnostic `__complete` protocol and active-help
- **shell-script-generators** (infra) — bash/zsh/fish/powershell script rendering, filesystem effect
- **doc-generators** (infra) — Markdown/ReST/man/YAML doc rendering, filesystem/clock/env effects

Every source file is owned by exactly one unit or listed under `excluded` with a reason; `unpartitioned` and `violations_observed` are empty. All effect declarations were reconciled against the linter's exact vocabulary (`env`, `filesystem`, `clock`, etc.), including one documented false-positive (a `*pflag.FlagSet` parameter named `fs` tripping the linter's crude `fs\.` regex).
